senses.gloss: (v. הָדַס, Pi.) to mark by means of incisions (cmp. כָּסַס).
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 89b:7">B. Bath. 89ᵇ</cite> <he>באתרא דמְהַנְדְּזֵי</he> Ms. (ed. <he>דמְהַנְדְּסֵי</he>) in a place where the authorities mark vessels used for measuring.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 89b:10">Ib.</cite> (<he>כל</he>) <he>כמה דלא מהנדזי לא שקיל</he> Ar. (Ms. H. <he>כל כמה דלא חזי הינדזא</he>; ed. only <he>לית לן בה</he>) what is beyond the mark of the vessel the purchaser will not accept (merely on the faith of the seller as to the quantity).

<cite ref="Chullin 43a:12">Ḥull. 43ᵃ</cite> <he>זימנין דמִיהַנְּדְּזִין וכ׳</he> at times (when the animal stretches its neck) the perforations in the two skins of the oesophagus may just exactly cover each other.
